top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Daily Menu, Including All Snacks and Meals Prepared or Served (26 TAC §744.401(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Menu was not posted during the inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Primary caregiver is lacking a statement of health from a local veterinarian.

top_violation_types.title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: There was a dog in the backyard without vaccinations record.

top_violation_types.title: Protective Barriers Around Porches or Platforms (26 TAC §747.4401(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The patio has about a 3 foot drop on the two sides and about 15 stairs in front. The provider is going to create a protective barrier around the patio, but it was not complete at the time of inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Medication No Longer Used (26 TAC §744.2659)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation had two expired medications at the operation for children that the medication was prescribed for.

top_violation_types.title: Required Admission Information-Child's allergies and Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §744.605(15))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two children with allergies had incomplete FARE forms as they were missing one medication listed for each child by the physician.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §744.2517(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Children did not wash hands before eating afternoon meal.

top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements- Letter or form from the most recent licensing inspection or investigation. (26 TAC §744.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have the letter or form from the most recent Licensing inspection or investigation posted.
